Start date: 1263-08-12  
Add 230 days:  

1263 has 31 days in August → +19 days → 1263-08-31 (19 added).  
Remaining: 230 − 19 = 211 days.  

September (30) → 211 − 30 = 181  
October (31) → 181 − 31 = 150  
November (30) → 150 − 30 = 120  
December (31) → 120 − 31 = 89  
January 1264 (31) → 89 − 31 = 58  
February 1264 (leap year? 1264 divisible by 4 → yes) → 58 − 29 = 29  
March (31) → 29 − 31 = −2 → so March 31 − 2 days = March 29.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1264-03-29
